title: Add Pricing Table
content: Create pricing section. Container: py-16 px-4. Header: text-center, title text-3xl font-bold, subtitle text-gray-600. Toggle: monthly/annual switch with discount badge. Cards: grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto. Card: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg p-8, popular card has ring-2 ring-blue-500 and "Popular" badge. Card content: plan name, price (large), billing period, feature list with checkmarks, CTA button. Popular card: different button color, larger scale.

variants.simple: Create pricing comparison table with plan cards.
variants.detailed: Create pricing section. Container: py-16 px-4. Header: text-center, title text-3xl font-bold, subtitle text-gray-600. Toggle: monthly/annual switch with discount badge. Cards: grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto. Card: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg p-8, popular card has ring-2 ring-blue-500 and "Popular" badge. Card content: plan name, price (large), billing period, feature list with checkmarks, CTA button. Popular card: different button color, larger scale.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive pricing component. Billing toggle: monthly/annual with animated switch, annual shows savings (e.g., "Save 20%"). Plan cards: 3-4 columns, recommended plan highlighted (scale-105, border, badge). Card structure: plan name, description, price with original crossed out if discount, feature list with check/x icons, CTA button, "Most popular" or "Best value" badge. Feature list: checkmark for included (text-green-500), X for excluded (text-gray-300), some features have tooltip for explanation. Feature comparison table: expandable section showing all features across plans in table format. Enterprise/Custom: separate card or row for custom pricing with "Contact us" CTA. Currency selector: dropdown to switch currencies. FAQ section: accordion below pricing for common questions. Guarantee badge: money-back guarantee callout. Trust signals: customer logos, testimonial quote. Mobile: stack cards vertically, swipeable carousel option. Animation: cards fade/slide in on scroll. A/B ready: props for different layouts/copy.
